title: Story-first daily layout correction
summary: Project iteration record for moving the public AI daily back from a PromptLayer-inspired visual report toward a story-first dense news product. The implementation adds generation-time story normalization and dedupe, withdraws the production PromptLayer theme, renders today's judgment, trend themes, and key stories first, and keeps project, community, ranking, and source coverage sections compact.

validation_commands: node --test tests/unit.test.js --test-name-pattern "2026-06-23 story-first replay|production daily does not enable PromptLayer|story-first interaction input"
Playwright desktop/mobile visual check for 2026-06-23 generated report

lessons.lesson: Daily news structure has to be generated as merged stories before rendering, not hidden by front-end sections.
lessons.evidence: The story-first normalizer is called from draft generation, report normalization, and site ingestion, and the 2026-06-23 replay now yields eight source-backed stories with duplicate appendix URLs pruned.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep duplicate suppression and evidence-level promotion rules in generation/write gates, then let the renderer consume only normalized story structures.

lessons.lesson: A visual theme can pass rendering checks while still harming the product task.
lessons.evidence: The PromptLayer-inspired production theme and ticket/card main stream were removed, while effective-interact pre-rendering, self-contained HTML, reduced-motion behavior, source/date/icon handling, and tracking components were retained.
lessons.recommended_action: Evaluate daily layout changes against three-minute scanning density and story distinctness, not only visual polish.

lessons.lesson: Navigation helpers must not call vertical scrollIntoView from active-link updates.
lessons.evidence: Mobile browser validation found that active nav link scrolling could pin the page near the navigation bar; the interaction UI now only adjusts the nav container's horizontal scroll position and the daily override keeps the nav non-sticky.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep mobile visual checks that explicitly scroll to the main story list after any navigation or layout changes.

suggestions.issue: The 2026-06-23 report replay exposed templated headlines, duplicate source URLs across public sections, and a production page shape that looked like a landing/report page instead of a dense daily news page.
suggestions.evidence: Tests now cover story-first replay, PromptLayer production disablement, source URL dedupe, community/secondary source demotion, seven-day duplicate suppression, content contract checks, and mobile story-list reachability.
suggestions.module: src/story-first.js, src/draft.js, src/report.js, src/site.js, src/interaction-report.js, scripts/check-daily-content-contract.mjs, tests/unit.test.js, tests/e2e/site.e2e.js
suggestions.suggestion: Promote story-first normalization to the default daily generation contract and keep low-signal source pools as compact appendices.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Readers can scan a small number of distinct source-backed stories first, while supporting sections remain available without competing with the main news judgment.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented in generation, write, site build, content contract, unit tests, e2e tests, and desktop/mobile Playwright validation.
validation_evidence: 2026-06-23 story-first replay normalizes legacy report into deduped stories
production daily does not enable PromptLayer-inspired theme or ticket grids
story-first generator reserves selected URLs across story and appendix sections

followups.action: Replace deterministic fallback story wording with stronger editorial clustering when the generator has richer candidate metadata for same-event multi-source merges.
